message: I've been diving into fire safety lately and came across some really handy tips that can turn a potentially scary situation into a cozy learning experience. Preparing for a fire doesn’t have to be all doom and gloom—it's more about getting everyone on the same page while having a little fun along the way. So, why not gather the family and chat about what to do in case of a fire? It could be a great excuse for some quality time together. Have you all talked about your fire plan yet?
